utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive! Sorry, I keep zoning out—I've been meaning to ask if they can help with my leaky faucet, but I haven't thought about electronics parts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No sweat, Noah! The drive is more for bikes and lawnmowers, but maybe someone there can point you to a plumber.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that's good to know. I'll still come by and ask around—maybe someone knows a plumber or I can just borrow a wrench.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, Dane, we're making good progress. I've got people helping with supplies and sorting tools—should be ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, sounds like you've got it all under control. I've got a busted toaster I've been meaning to bring in—think you guys can handle that?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, Dane, bring it by—I'm sure someone can take a look at it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that repair drive? I still haven't seen any official notice, so forgive me if I'm not convinced.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: You know, I'm actually a bit worried about that too—let's see if we can get the official plan before committing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Exactly, let's not jump into anything until we see something in writing or from the board.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, repair drive? Saturday? Yeah, sounds good, just let me know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Bo, you're a lifesaver! Just bring whatever's broken and a cheerful attitude—Jerry's convinced that drive can fix anything, even if he once thought his car could fly!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Ha, Jerry's something else. I'll just grab my busted toaster and see you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Ira, do you have any special tools or parts we might need for the electronics? I want to be sure we're fully prepared.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I've heard we might need some small screwdrivers and maybe a multimeter—let me grab those from the hardware store while I'm out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks Ira! A multimeter and small screwdrivers sound exactly right — could you also pick up a pack of assorted switches and wiring just in case?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh Gus, I heard from Ira that the repair drive is at Bob's garage—I'm still getting the hang of it, but I'm happy to help out!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, so we're all on the same page! I'll be there Saturday morning to set up the workstations. Let me know if you need any extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks Gus! I'll see you there—maybe I'll bring my broken lamp too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I'm so glad you're in! We're meeting at my place at 9 AM on Saturday, and then we'll head over to Mr. Henderson's together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: At your place? Got it, I'll be there with extra nails and maybe some spare gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, thanks Opal! See you Saturday at 9, and thanks for bringing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Uli, I'm so glad you're here! We could really use your help with sorting donations before the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, thank you Uli! Let's start by grouping the tools and spare parts into those piles over there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Pia, have you had a chance to check that drive's capacity yet? I'd like to know before we start piling on more tasks.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Drive's at 10, not 9. I'll be at the community center with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, 10 should be enough for now. Thanks for the update, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center? We're fixing old appliances.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I'll be there! I've got some tools ready, do you need me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Sam! Could you bring extra screwdrivers? I think we'll need a few, and Noah's already bringing his toaster, so we'll be ready for anything!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Cleo! I'm glad you're here—can you help me gather the extra tools for the repair drive? We're set for 10 at the center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, Mara! I've got a bin of wrenches and screwdrivers I was about to bring over. Want me to grab that now?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be perfect, Cleo! Grab that bin and meet me at the center—we'll get everything sorted before folks start arriving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I got Gus bringing his toolbox, so don't worry about bringing extra tools. Just bring yourself!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, so Gus has it covered. I'll just show up then—what time are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We're kicking off at 9 AM sharp. I'll send out a quick reminder to everyone tonight so we're all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I keep forgetting about that. What's the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's going to be a blast! We've got folks bringing all sorts of broken things—lawnmowers, toasters—and Jerry's convinced that drive can fix anything short of a broken heart!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: A lawnmower? Huh, maybe I should finally drag that old one out of my garage.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Oh right, is that today? I thought it was next week... did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No, you didn't miss it—it's still going on! Folks have been dropping stuff off at Bob's garage all week. Need me to grab anything from the hardware store while I'm out?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that's a relief! I thought I'd gone and forgotten the whole thing. Actually, could you pick up some fuses? I think I need them for... something.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia! You're coming to the repair drive this Saturday, right? We're fixing up Mr. Henderson's fence and could really use your help!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, the repair drive? I'd love to help, but I'm in the middle of sorting out the backup drive space right now. Can we talk about Saturday after I get this sorted?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing, Pia! Just let me know when you're free—I'll save a spot for you at the fence fixing crew!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Kira, I'm so glad you're here! Just a heads-up, the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center—hope you can still join!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, moved to Sunday? Are you sure about that? I haven't heard any official announcement about a change.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh yes, Kira, I just got the confirmation myself—the flyers are being updated as we speak. It'll be 10 AM on Sunday at the community center instead.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Vik, do you have a moment? I wanted to see if you could lend a hand with the repair drive sorting this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Rey, absolutely! The repair drive is this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center—Noah's already bringing his toaster, and we could use all the help we can get sorting the appliances!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Perfect, thanks Vik. Could you help me check that all the donated tools have clear labels before folks start showing up?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, exactly — it's at Mr. Henderson's place this Saturday at 9 AM, not the community center. My mistake earlier!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks for the correction. So, are you bringing your own tools or should I bring some extras?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'll bring my own toolbox — got a good set of wrenches and screwdrivers that might come in handy!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Bo, I've been double-checking our list for the repair drive—do you know if anyone's mentioned needing any specialized tools or parts I might have missed?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, I think someone mentioned needing a soldering iron? But honestly, I'm not sure—I've been too swamped to keep track.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: A soldering iron—okay, I'll add that to the list. Do you remember who said it, or should I check with the others to confirm?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, sorry I'm late again—did I miss any sign-ups for the repair drive? My toaster's still on the blink.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Dane! We're still taking walk-ins at the repair drive starting at 10 AM at the community center. I'll put your name on the list for the toaster.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks Mara, you're a lifesaver. I'll make sure to get there early and bring my toaster in a bag so it doesn't cause a mess.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: So Jules, do you think we'll be done by 3? I've got to pick up the kids from school.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm sure we'll manage, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's reassuring, Uli. I just don't want to keep the kids waiting.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Looks like everyone's getting ready for the repair drive—want me to swing by and help load up your gear, Mara?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, if you're helping Mara, I can grab those sturdy boxes and blankets Hana mentioned from my garage—just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That'd be perfect, Jules—those boxes and blankets will really help keep things secure. I'll meet you both at Mara's in a few.
